subject: general
question: Which of the following is the study of vibrations within Earth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seismology.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Seismology**

__
 
• **Seismology is the study of earthquakes and seismic waves **that move through and around the Earth.
 
• **A seismologist is a scientist who studies earthquakes and seismic waves.**
 
• An example of seismology is geological surveying.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **Graphology**

 
• **Graphology is the analysis of handwriting **with an attempt to determine someone's personality traits.
 
• The theory underlying graphology is that handwriting is an expression of personality.

**Ichthyology**

 
• **Ichthyology is the branch of zoology devoted to the study of fish**, including: bony fish, Osteichthyes; cartilaginous fish, Chondrichthyes; and jawless fish, Agnatha.
 
• The discipline can include the biology, taxonomy and conservation of fish, as well as husbandry and commercial fisheries.

**Selenology**

 
• **Selenology is a branch of astronomy that deals with the moon.**
 
• Selenologist is a scientist who studies the physical features of the moon.
